Problem: Inconsistencies observed for user K932EPQ8IG8 in tenant . Assigning roles or work centers to the user takes a long time, and tables are not displayed correctly when the user logs into C4C. Other users are functioning properly. The issue is specific to the replicated user K932EPQ8IG8 and does not occur with other users. The problem is reproducible during actions like assigning roles or checking changes tab, with slow performance observed consistently.
solution provided: The development team removed all existing role assignments for the affected user and then tested the functionality by reassigning and de-assigning the work centers. After performing these steps, the performance returned to normal, and the issue could no longer be reproduced. The affected user had a very large number of change log entries (more than 2 million records), which was likely contributing to the performance degradation. The solution involved clearing the inconsistencies by removing all existing assignments and then reassigning the required work centers. This refreshed the assignments and helped eliminate any inconsistencies that may exist within those tenants.

Problem: Performance issues observed with OData queries and Web Services in the productive tenant compared to the test tenant. OData queries result in timeout errors or significantly slower processing times in the productive tenant. Web Service payloads for creating Purchase Proposals take over 7 minutes to process in the productive tenant, compared to 10-20 seconds in the test tenant. Error message encountered: 'In the context of Data Services an MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA internal server error occurred.' Issue started on 2026/02/09. Business operations are seriously threatened as urgent tasks cannot be executed. Integration with IBP for creation of Purchase Proposals is stopped due to errors with OData and Web Services. Purchasing stopped for the whole system.
solution provided: The issue is specific to the virtual data source (Scmmsdvv02) and the virtual class CL_MSDV_MDAV_IMPL, which is taking more time to fetch data. The data volume in the productive tenant is significantly larger than in the test tenant, which contributes to the performance issues. Recommendations include reducing the data volume by selecting fewer fields or adding more filters. The engineering team suggested reducing the data volume to mitigate high memory consumption during data source execution. The customer was informed of the final analysis results based on the HTTP trace investigation. The findings and conclusions were discussed in detail, and all customer questions were addressed. The customer acknowledged the results and confirmed that no further action is required from the support side. The customer approved the closure of the case.

Problem: The resources LR0165 and LR0166 are not found in the Cost and Revenue work center for specific users. The issue occurs when the resource has two or more cost centers assigned under its Valuation tab. Users receive an error message 'Postings to resource LR0165 found; change/deletion not possible' when attempting to make changes.
solution provided: For Resource LR0165 and LR0166, perform a dummy change under the Valuation tab by deleting one of the cost centers, saving, and then adding it again. If error messages are encountered, report an incident to MASKED_ORG for backend correction to bypass the validation and perform the dummy change. Once the dummy change is successfully executed, the resources should become visible to the user in the Cost and Revenue work center.

Problem: The incident involves a plan to correct and execute 80 Goods and Activity Confirmations (GACs) over 5 weekends to avoid impact on daily operations and inventory valuation. The process includes sending documents in batches, uploading stock, performing backend corrections, and ensuring the system is clean for daily movements. There is also a need to address one remaining document that was not found on the discussed lists.
solution provided: The proposed solution involves a staggered approach over 5 weekends, with specific tasks assigned to each day of the weekend. The plan includes sending batches of documents on Friday nights, uploading stock on Saturdays, performing backend corrections on Saturday nights/Sundays, and ensuring the system is clean by Sunday nights. Additionally, a joint meeting between the relevant parties is suggested to address the remaining documents. The plan aims to ensure zero impact on live inventory and requires a 24-hour turnaround commitment during the weekends.

Problem: An exception error appears in the Removal screen for a quantity of -432 linked with a specific customer demand. The error persists even though all related documents are completed and the quantity does not exist in the stock overview or product planning page. The customer has requested a root cause analysis for the issue.
solution provided: The customer has approved the deletion of the exception error in the Removal process. The support team has created a clone system to investigate the issue further. The clone system creation required coordination with the Operations team and involved several steps, including resolving production bug fixes and scheduling downtime. The support team is currently analyzing the issue from the clone system and will provide an update by 27 August 2026.

Problem: The daily job IAM_INVALID_USER_AUTH_REMOVAL fails due to an error saying 'No more memory available to extend an internal table.' This issue prevents the automatic revocation of business roles and substitutions for users whose 'Valid To' date is set in the past. The job is supposed to run around 5:15 AM CET and complete within 24 hours, but it has not been functioning correctly for approximately one month.
solution provided: The solution involves several steps to address the memory issue and ensure the job runs successfully. These steps include:\1. Enabling the scoping question to ensure 'Do MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA want to remove substitutions and authorizations for users whose validity date is in the past?' is activated in the tenant.\2. Identifying affected users whose validity period shows 01/01/0001 to 01/01/0001.\3. Manually updating the 'Valid To' date for each affected user to trigger the system's auto-revocation background job.\4. For replication scenarios, ensuring accurate validity dates are transmitted from the source system to C4C.\5. Removing substitutions of specific users or extending their 'Valid To' date into the future to clear blockers.\6. Reviewing the current configuration to ensure it aligns with how substitutes are intended to work.\7. Submitting an idea on the MASKED_ORG influence website if the current behavior does not fit the day-to-day process.

Problem: MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA encountered a discrepancy of 1 quantity between accounting and logistics for materialPM1801PV during year-end material reconciliation. The Material Reconciliation Report shows a difference of 1 quantity despite 11 quantities being received and issued/consumed. This discrepancy is affecting core business processes, including financial reporting and audit reconciliation, and is delaying year-end closing activities.
solution provided: The root cause of the discrepancy was identified as a failed XI message for a Goods and Service Confirmation (GAC) document ID: 121610, which was not posted to accounting. The solution involved cancelling the GAC ID: 121610 via the UI, generating a failed MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA message, and then having Technical Support (TS) cancel the failed MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA message. This process fully reversed the incorrect transaction and eliminated the inventory reconciliation difference.

Problem: The MASKED_ORG platform is rejecting ISO 20022 payment files due to missing tags and required information. The customer has conducted multiple tests with different suppliers and consistently encounters the same errors. The issue affects business operations and delays the planned implementation of ISO 20022 payment processing with MASKED_ORG.
solution provided: The solution provided involves enabling the 'Execute Immediately' checkbox during outgoing bank transfer creation. This option can be found on the 'View All' screen. Enabling this checkbox will automatically include the required tags in the payment file, specifically the 'URGP' tag. Additionally, it was suggested to use the XSLT Bank transfer payment medium format in the bank master data configuration for both domestic and international bank transfers.

Problem: The customer reported an error stating 'UUID of Intrastat Worklist Item 31104, 31120, and 10042 is not unique. Please create an incident.' This issue occurred while accessing the Application Log 12033532 in the Information Lifecycle Management work center. The customer also faced a memory issue that caused a dump when trying to open the Application Log 11870903, resulting in a 500 Internal Server Error.
Solution provided: The memory extension was successfully performed by the support team, which resolved the memory-related dump issue. Additionally, the backend correction for the UUID uniqueness issue was completed, and the customer was advised to verify the behavior to confirm the resolution.

Problem: The purchase order cannot be finished because of a budget error. The system shows an error message indicating that the budget for Project Task DCP31 is exceeded by 10,000 GBP. The customer expects the system to calculate the remaining budget correctly and provide an accurate error message.
solution provided: The system behavior is working as designed. The budget exceedance message is expected because the currently available budget is GBP 9,500, which is GBP 500 less than the purchase order value being processed. The budget monitoring report remains the authoritative source used by Active Budget Control for budget validation. The system compares the value of the new commitment directly against the total project budget, ensuring that budget control is enforced at the overall project level rather than incrementally based on remaining balances.

Problem: Time Account Accrual posts on Friday instead of Saturday. Time Account Accrual posts on both Friday and Saturday. All Time Account accruals are configured in Business Configuration to post on Saturday of every week. Accrual issues are inconsistent and do not always occur for the same employees. A [PERSON NAME] scheduled for every Monday usually corrects most of the issues but frequently encounters errors. Backdated time entries are being posted, which may impact the Day Closure Run and Time Account Accrual postings. Example provided for employee 5218 shows Time Account accrual postings done twice on 06/03/2026 and 07/03/2026.
solution provided: The issue could not be conclusively reproduced in either the customer's environment or the internal test environment. The scheduled time account accrual process behaved as expected and no duplicate postings were generated. Based on the available system logs, the duplicate postings were associated with user-initiated updates rather than the scheduled background accrual job. While user actions are suspected to have contributed to the behavior, the available historical data is not sufficient to conclusively identify the exact action or confirm it as the definitive root cause. To accurately determine the root cause, further analysis is required when the issue occurs again. The customer is requested to provide the affected employee ID(s) and authorize further analysis to verify whether the duplicate accrual postings were generated by the scheduled background process or triggered by a user action.

Problem: Timesheets are slow and unworkable, preventing users from editing effectively. Multiple server errors have been reported during timesheet editing. The issue is recurrent and has affected several users. The problem is in the BYD module of the MASKED_ORG SuccessFactors Platform.
solution provided: The issue requires a product enhancement, which has been planned for inclusion in the 2611 release. The fix will be delivered as part of the standard release cycle. The development team has completed a comprehensive investigation and feasibility assessment. Users are advised to contact support if they experience further issues in the meantime.

Problem: Users are able to perform time recording after exceeding planned work hours without any error. This issue affects core business processes and results in financial loss as the project cost calculations and monthly financial reports are incorrect. The issue impacts 100 users.
solution provided: The issue is caused by time entries being recorded without a maintained duration, which leads the system to allow additional hours to be recorded beyond the planned working hours. The solution is to update the duration for all existing time entries and ensure that the duration or corresponding start/end time is maintained when creating new time entries. Additionally, if a time entry needs to be cancelled, it should be removed directly rather than making the duration empty or zero. Following this procedure will ensure that the time entries and corresponding project actual hours are recorded correctly.

Problem: The TXT file generated from the extraction run for financial data does not display the expected selection parameters such as Company, set of books, chosen Accounting period, and display currency. This is causing processing issues on the tax authorities' side.
Solution provided: The development team confirmed that the selection parameters are not included in the downloaded file during the extraction run. This functionality is not available in any of the existing systems and would be considered a new enhancement rather than a defect. The customer is advised to submit an enhancement request through the MASKED_ORG Influence Portal to have the request evaluated and prioritized by the relevant product team.

Problem: The system crashes while approving Supplier Invoice 9080. The invoice contains a large number of line items (318 items), which exceeds the system's processing capacity. This issue is causing performance problems and preventing the invoice from being approved.
solution provided: The developers have voided the supplier invoice from their end. The customer is requested to create a new supplier invoice by splitting the line items, including the cost distribution. The system can handle up to 100 line items (including cost distribution). If the number of line items exceeds 100, the system may result in a dump/error. The customer is advised to proceed accordingly.

Problem: The customer encountered an issue with supplier invoice allocation and cancellation, leading to inconsistencies in the document flow. An initial allocation document was created and later cancelled. Before cancellation, an additional journal entry (adjustment) was posted, leading to a variance in the total allocated amount. During the allocation cancellation, the system considered the original amount instead of the adjusted/net amount, resulting in no journal entry being created and a stuck message with the error 'Asset condition violated.' Restarting the message did not resolve the issue. A subsequent allocation document was created with the correct amount but was posted with reference quantity = 0 in the landed cost line item report.
solution provided: The support team is collaborating with the development team to investigate the issue. They have requested a copy of the current setup or a test environment where the issue can be reproduced to safely make necessary corrections and verify the request before applying changes in the production environment. The team is also working on replicating the issue in their internal systems to better understand the root cause and provide an appropriate resolution.

Problem: Problems extracting data via the new self-service function in Application and User Management - Attachment Extraction. Attachments extraction status shows 'failed' for various documents. Output history files extraction status shows 'failed' despite documents being in 'successful' status. Numerous documents in User Management Attachment Overview remain in 'pending' status even after re-executing the extraction run. Unable to identify the root cause for the failures or pending statuses. Over 10,000 documents are in 'failed' or 'pending' status, making it unmanageable to review each document individually. Attempts to reset the status and rerun the extraction did not resolve the issue.
solution provided: The root cause of the issue was an incorrect client registration configuration, which has now been corrected. Since the client is using an SAP-managed SharePoint tenant, the issue was identified as being related to the client registration setup. The Client Authorization Server and Client App Server URI were configured differently. After validating the setup, the correct client registration configuration was maintained. Following the correction, the extraction process was successfully tested and confirmed that the files were extracted to SharePoint without any issues. Additionally, the documents that were previously showing a 'Failed' status in the Attachment Overview screen were extracted. The client can also review any remaining failed or pending documents that have not yet been extracted to SharePoint.

Problem: The incident involves an error during the validation of migration objects for Material and Material Valuation Data in a productive SAP Business ByDesign system. The error occurs during the 'Simulate Import' step, preventing the completion of the migration process. This issue seriously affects business operations as it prevents the registration of master data and the creation of subsequent documents.
solution provided: The solution provided involves several steps and recommendations: 1. Ensure that the migration file is properly synchronized and contains no data inconsistencies. 2. Use the latest migration templates downloaded via 'Download Migration Template'. 3. Correct the 'Distribution Channel' field in the 'Sales' tab to use key values (e.g., 01 for Direct Sales, 02 for Indirect Sales) instead of descriptions. 4. Ensure that the extension field EXT-YI48BJF1Y_F00036C807A88370 is correctly maintained in the source file with the corresponding currency code. 5. Delete and reupload the problematic file (JA__20260818105214.xml) from the migration tool and execute the migration process again. 6. Use the 'Maximum View' option during the upload process to avoid issues with input fields not displaying properly.

Problem: The MASKED_LOCATION business user is able to see the MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA employee in the Compensation work center in Employees view, which is not expected. This causes a segregation of duty conflict where employees see data they are not supposed to see.
solution provided: The issue is being investigated and diagnosed with the development team. The business user view was checked, and it was found that the view HCM_COMPEMPLOYEES is restricted but not selected for read or write for the specific reporting line unit. The issue is still open and updates are pending from the development team.

Problem: Intercompany PO transactions between entities show discrepancies in tax calculation. Specifically, transactions between US0100000 and US0200000 have an incorrect tax calculation with a 7% tax rate, while transactions between US0300000 and US0600000 have a correct tax calculation with a 0% tax rate. The issue is due to inconsistent tax jurisdiction maintenance in the supplier master data and the tax engine's behavior in intercompany scenarios.
solution provided: The current system design does not fully meet the business requirement. The requested change would require a modification to the existing tax engine functionality and may have a broader impact across all customers. It is recommended to submit this as an enhancement request through the Influence Portal for a detailed evaluation by the product team. Additionally, the tax jurisdiction should be consistently maintained in the supplier master data to ensure accurate tax calculations.

Problem: The customer reported that after changing the depreciation start date for a fixed asset, the depreciation is not being recalculated correctly. There is a discrepancy between the depreciation updated by the backend and the amount derived through formula-based calculation. The customer is unable to close financial books due to this issue, which is critically affecting their core business processes and may result in financial loss.
solution provided: The development team investigated the issue and found that the discrepancy is likely due to incorrect migration data. They recommended verifying and correcting the acquisition cost in the migration file, reloading the migration data, and recalculating the depreciation. Additionally, they suggested aligning the useful life settings in different valuation views and executing the depreciation run in update mode to resolve any pending postings. The team is also checking other migrated fixed assets data in the test system and will schedule a call with the customer to conclude the issue.

Problem: The Company Financial Posting Control functionality, which allows posting source documents with a proposed posting date in a closed fiscal year/accounting period into the current fiscal year and date, is not working properly. Some Customer Project Expense Lists (CPELs) are not being posted automatically and are appearing with a period lock error. This issue has been observed in both the productive and test systems.

In the meantime, the customer is advised to manually post any unposted versions into the current accounting period. The development team is expected to report back with their findings.

Problem: The incident involves several issues related to the MASKED_ORG ILM Business Document Retention, Validation, and Deletion Functionality. Specific problems include:  - Error during Lifecycle Analysis Run: 'UUID of Intrastat Worklist Item F51C_500874 is not unique. Please create a case.'  - Error during Lifecycle Analysis Run: 'UUID of General Ledger Report TB 2016P05 is missing. Please create a case.'  - Missing Log IDs after successful validation runs.  - Questions regarding the validation process flow and report data visibility.  These issues are preventing the validation of the MASKED_ORG ILM deletion process and moving forward with the planned archiving implementation, posing a risk of non-compliance with retention policies.
solution provided: The solutions provided include:  - For the error 'UUID of Intrastat Worklist Item F51C_500874 is not unique. The translation for the values 'purchasing department' and 'general applications' are switched. This issue affects business operations due to dysfunctional processes, with no workaround available.

Problem: Process Communication Errors for two [PERSON NAME] documents: 9SI_4619_2026 and 9SI_4896_2026. Error message: 'Tax amt. not equal to sum of deductible and non-deduct. amt. for doc.' Users cannot proceed with accounting posting.
solution provided: Change the deductible amount to match the tax amount and then post the invoice. If the error persists, go to Actions -> Calculate Total Amounts, then click Check again. Additionally, ensure the posting period is open for operational postings in the UI.

Problem: When using the New Multiple Checks function to create incoming payments from customers, the payment allocation task is not posted automatically by the system for certain customers. This issue was reproduced in the customer's test system where one payment allocation was posted automatically while another remained in preparation status.
solution provided: The issue is due to the activation of the new payment register in the system. Automatic allocation is possible only under specific conditions: the Customer Account Monitor does not contain any other payable payment types, or if other payable items are present, at least one open invoice must be available for automatic allocation. The development team confirmed this as standard behavior. The proposed solution involves ensuring that the conditions for automatic allocation are met, such as clearing any open items in the customer account monitor.

Problem: The payment method field in supplier invoices gets deleted by the system upon posting the invoice. The field is set as 'mandatory' and cannot be edited after deletion, causing issues when cancelling the invoice. Error message: 'MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA rejected because field ([PERSON NAME]) is defined as mandatory by key user.'
solution provided: To resolve the issue, the following steps were taken: 1. Make the Bank ID field mandatory through a KUT configuration, or ensure that a valid Bank ID is entered whenever Bank Transfer is used. 2. Temporarily remove the mandatory configuration from the Payment Method field to cancel or process the affected invoices. 3. Re-enable the mandatory field configuration according to business requirements once all impacted invoices have been handled. Additionally, a Knowledge Base Article (KBA) was created to describe this behavior and the recommended solution.

Problem: Customer wants to activate the EUBP function for both their production and test tenants. The activation process faced technical difficulties and was dependent on the 2608 release update.
solution provided: The EUBP feature was enabled in the test server and is active. The customer was instructed to verify the function and confirm if they would like it activated in the production tenant as well. The development team worked on resolving technical issues and waited for the 2608 release to proceed with the activation.

Specifically, the errors are 'Referenced item B860000748-2450 of Contract B860000748 not found' and 'Referenced item of Contract B860000748 not found' for customer invoices. This issue is affecting business operations due to the inability to post source documents, which may result in incorrect billing. The root cause is identified as memory limitations in the backend system, leading to time-out errors and failed messages.

The development team recommends closing the existing contract and creating a new one to avoid further processing issues. Additionally, access to a clone system that replicates the production environment is requested for a comprehensive investigation and detailed analysis.

Problem: The OData query is not fetching the employee ID of the manager assigned to the org unit for a few employees. This issue affects multiple employees and org units, with some employees having multiple entries in the OData query due to being assigned as managers to multiple org units.

The asset has multiple historical retirement and reversal-related postings, and the issue originated from a manual backend correction performed during the processing of Customer Invoice 49.

This is because the retirement posting cannot be completed due to the detected inconsistency in the asset values.

The only difference identified in the files is the number of repeated transaction nodes, while the XML structure and tag set remain identical. Problem: The user encountered a runtime error during the Lease Posting Closure Run for company 4200, set of books 10. The error message 'Application runtime exception; report a case' occurred. This issue arose when creating a new Lease Posting Run with the selection set to Fix-Closure. The problem was caused by multiple changes to the version dates, leading to data inconsistency in Lease Contract #264.
solution provided: The proposed solution involves reversing the latest Lease Posting Run (2025-02-00000071) only for Lease Contract #264, re-running the lease posting run, and then performing the lease clearing and closure runs. This process will refresh and recalculate the lease contract data, resolving the data inconsistency. Additionally, the support team suggested reviewing the documentation 3470924 for further details on the error.

Problem: When the user opens the filter dropdown in the contracts overview and selects 'Automated Tasks with Errors', the system stops responding and displays a 500 Internal Server Error. This prevents the filtered contract list from being displayed, seriously affecting business operations as urgent tasks cannot be executed.
Solution provided: The issue was caused by missing linkage in the application logs. The development team performed a backend correction to resolve the inconsistency. The issue was confirmed to be resolved after the correction.

Problem: The Revenue Recognition run in the customer system is encountering errors such as 'No expense posting for price determination' and 'No material price in valuation quantity unit'. The errors occur intermittently and disappear after the sales order is delivered. The root cause is related to the mismatch between the pricing date in the sales order and the validity dates in the Material Valuation master data. Additionally, there are questions about how the cost data is derived and why the error occurs intermittently.
solution provided: The solution involves ensuring that the validity dates in the Material Valuation match or precede the Pricing Date of the document. Specifically, update the Pricing Date on the sales order/line item to a date within the valid cost range. Verify other sales orders to ensure the Pricing Date falls within the Valid From and Valid To range maintained in the Material Valuation master data. Once the cost validity dates align with the pricing dates, re-run the Revenue Recognition task. Additionally, it was suggested to deactivate the PDI solution and re-run the Revenue Recognition task to see if the issue persists.

Problem: Error in Revenue Recognition Run: Product TOPSOLID-000795 of order 32851/10: No expense posting for price determination. The issue is caused by a quantity conversion (1ea=0,00000001 hrs) that creates inconsistencies, resulting in the error message. The revenue recognition run cannot be processed successfully, impacting month-end closing and affecting 15 users.
solution provided: The development team confirmed that the quantity conversion creates inconsistencies. The customer can create a specific resource with a zero cost rate and assign it to the respective sales order item, or work with a general conversion such as 1 ea = 1 hr. Alternatively, the error only appears as long as the sales order item is not completed. Once the final delivery or invoice date is set and the revenue recognition run's posting date is on or after this date, the error no longer appears. The team also suggested executing the revenue recognition run from the backend to skip the price determination check so that all sales order items can be processed.

Problem: Customer is facing the error 'RABAX occurred on server side' when using the 'querycustomerin' service. The issue is related to the 'SelectionByLastChangeSinceDateTime' parameter not working correctly with certain timestamps, causing a date format error in the XML for ABAP. This has a moderate business impact as it affects the Webshop customer sync and dependent sync jobs.
Solution provided: The solution provided is to update the parameter name from 'SelectionByLastChangeSinceDateTime' to 'SelectionByChangedSinceDateTime'. This change has been tested and confirmed to resolve the error, resulting in a successful response from the service.

Problem: GDPR deletion of personal data fails, even after executing Lifecycle Analysis Runs and following the standard deletion process. The issue is related to missing cumulative totals and the presence of documents with unlimited retention end dates, which prevents the deletion of the business partner.
solution provided: The issue is caused by missing cumulative totals and documents with unlimited retention end dates. To resolve the issue, cumulative totals must be generated as part of the year-end closing process. Problem: MASKED_ORG is experiencing issues with MASKED_ORG payments due to the error 'General ledger account alias PUK0535 does not exist'. This error occurs because the account determination validation for MASKED_ORG payments is activated, which is unnecessary as these payments go directly to the supplier PUK0535. solution provided: The 'Basic Check Failed Indicator' was already checked when MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA fetched the data into MASKED_ORG ByD. The issue was resolved by removing the 'BasicCheckFailedIndicator' from the backend, which allowed the expense reports to be posted successfully. MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA confirmed that the 'BasicCheckFailedIndicator' field is being populated in the ByD system from MASKED_ORG. The proposed solution is to create and resubmit the expense reports without the 'BasicCheckFailedIndicator' being checked. Further investigation is required from MASKED_ORG's side to determine why the Basic Check Fail Indicator was set to True.

Problem: The customer is experiencing inconsistencies in the document numbering sequence for Outgoing Bank Transfers, where document numbers are not being generated in an expected sequential order. This behavior is causing concerns regarding transaction traceability, audit compliance, and reconciliation processes. The customer is unable to confirm whether the observed behavior is functioning as designed or indicates an underlying system issue. solution provided: The issue is a standard system behavior of the MASKED_ORG Business ByDesign system, where the payment document ID is generated based on a combination of parameters such as Company Code, Payment Method, Business Partner, Bank Account, and [PERSON NAME]. This logic is part of the standard system design defined by MASKED_ORG and is consistently followed across multiple MASKED_ORG ByDesign customer systems. The document ID will start the numbering with 1 when a new fiscal year starts. This is standard system behavior and is based on the calendar year. A relevant KBA document (KBA: 2354540 - Payment Document Numbers Missing/Skipped) has been provided as an official MASKED_ORG reference to explain the payment discrepancy to the customer's auditors.

Problem: The MASKED_ORG Security team identified several critical and high-severity vulnerabilities in the MASKED_ORG C4C MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA endpoint. These include Unrestricted File Upload (Stored XSS), Application-Layer DoS (OData Query Abuse), Mass Assignment (Operational SLA Bypass), Identity Spoofing (Confused Deputy / BOLA), and Missing Security Headers (Defense in Depth). These vulnerabilities need to be remediated before the planned production launch on June 25th.
solution provided: The following solutions were provided to address the identified vulnerabilities:\1. Unrestricted File Upload (Stored XSS): MASKED_ORG must implement strict server-side validation of the actual file content, rejecting any file that does not match a secure whitelist (e.g., PDF, DOCX).\2. Application-Layer DoS (OData Query Abuse): Configure strict OData limits in MASKED_ORG, such as enforcing pagination with a maximum of 50/100 records per page for $top and restricting the allowed depth/nodes for $expand.\3. Mass Assignment (Operational SLA Bypass): The integration layer in GCP must sanitize the payload before sending it, forwarding only a strict whitelist of authorized parameters to MASKED_ORG.\4. Identity Spoofing (Confused Deputy / BOLA): The backend must extract the ReportedPartyID securely and exclusively from the authenticated employee's session token (SSO/JWT). It must never trust an ID inferred by the LLM or provided via user prompt.\5. Missing Security Headers (Defense in Depth): Apply critical security headers at the MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA Gateway level, including X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options to prevent Clickjacking attacks.

Address the temporary glitch causing the product category missing issue. 5. Use the correct posting period and maintain the account determination and product category as per KBA 3561680. 6. Use the 'ManageSupplierInvoiceIn' service available in the Service Explorer as recommended by the development team.

Problem: Unexpected exchange rate difference posting to GL Account 976200 in MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA of Customer Invoice IE24-14609. solution provided: The solution involves understanding that this behavior is standard and driven by different conversion dates for accounting and tax. Problem: Attachments are not getting created in SharePoint. All documents in the attachment overview are showing the status as 'Pending'. Problem: The customer is unable to cancel a Stock Transfer Order (STO) line item in the customer demand view. Problem: The customer is unable to upload multiple documents of the same type 'Specification & Results' under the Inspection document 1084. The system throws an error stating that the document type must be unique. Additionally, the customer wants to set the default document type to 'Technical Drawing' when the attachment upload window is opened.
Solution provided: The system configuration for the document type 'Specification & Results' is set with both the Default Indicator and Unique Indicator enabled, which means only one document of this type can be uploaded. Problem: Process Communication Error between Inbound Delivery Request and Logistics Execution Request. The error message indicates a failure in linking the fulfilled schedule line with the confirmed schedule line. This issue affects system transparency and may lead to delays in operational processes, as well as increased manual effort for monitoring and follow-up.
Solution provided: The solution involves several steps to resolve the Process Communication Error (PCE). First, the invoice associated with Third-Party Outbound Delivery 1782 needs to be canceled. After the invoice is canceled, the release of Third-Party Outbound Delivery 1782 will be undone from the backend. Once this is completed, the Third-Party Inbound Delivery Notification (IDN) 1776_1 will be released again, which should automatically release the corresponding Third-Party Inbound Delivery 5527 and Third-Party Outbound Delivery 1782, thereby restoring the document flow and resolving the PCE.

Problem: The City field is configured as mandatory in the master data for suppliers in the production system, but suppliers can be saved without a City. The mandatory configuration for the City and State fields was removed in the test environment, aligning it with the standard application behavior. After this change, the supplier record could be saved successfully without encountering any errors, making the behavior consistent across the internal systems, production environment, and test environment.
